subject: science
concept: Distinguishing inherited traits from traits acquired through environment or experience
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Heredity) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts trait examples into 'inherited' and 'acquired through environment/experience' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described trait to whether it's passed genetically or learned/developed
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a described trait is inherited or acquired, not both

misconception_flags: assumes a learned skill or scar is passed on genetically to offspring

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
